diagnosis: [MOCK] Your documents show two different versions of your name, so the passport office cannot confirm they belong to the same person.
likely_causes: The name on your Class 10 certificate differs from the name on your Aadhaar.

recommended_path.name: Prove both names belong to you
steps: Ask your Passport Seva Kendra which affidavit they accept for a name difference.
Prepare that affidavit stating both versions of your name.
Resubmit with a short covering letter that refers to your file.

alternatives.name: Notarised affidavit plus a newspaper notice
alternatives.when_it_applies: If your passport office asks for public notice of the name difference.

conflicts.issue: Sources disagree on whether the affidavit must be attested by an executive magistrate or a notary.
conflicts.what_decides_it: Your passport office's practice. Ask before you prepare the affidavit.

similar_cases.summary: A file was closed over a name difference between Aadhaar and a school certificate.

citations.title: Kaanoon: file closure notification letter received from RPO Chandigarh

unknowns: Which attestation route your passport office accepts.
disclaimer: Guidance only, not legal advice. Confirm with the Passport Office.
